title: Inflector
subtitle: Normalize names, keys, and query result columns
intro: Apply consistent naming conventions to strings, struct keys, or every column of a query. Combine case conversion with English inflection helpers when cleaning imported schemas, generating identifiers, or shaping data for another system.

reference.name: inflect(format, value)
reference.description: Transform a string or rename keys in a struct.

reference.name: FROM inflect(format, (query))
reference.description: Rename all result columns from a query.

reference.name: inflector_to_snake_case(text)
reference.description: Convert a single name to snake_case.

reference.name: inflector_to_camel_case(text)
reference.description: Convert a single name to camelCase.

reference.name: inflector_to_table_case(text)
reference.description: Build a plural snake_case table name.

reference.name: inflector_to_singular(word)
reference.description: Apply English singularization rules; check irregular edge cases.

notes.title: Select the shape you mean
notes.body: inflect changes string contents, struct field names, or result column names according to the input type. Values inside a renamed struct or query remain unchanged. Common formats include snake, camel, pascal, and kebab.

notes.title: Check English edge cases
notes.body: Inflection is English-specific and is not always reversible. Fixed v1.5 builds singularize people to person and children to child; older ac9b69f leaves these unchanged. Validate the vocabulary and acronym conventions that matter to your data.

examples.title: Normalize nested data keys
examples.caption: Pass a STRUCT; field names change while their values stay intact.

examples.title: Rename a complete result
examples.caption: Replace the inner SELECT with your import or transformation query.

examples.title: Derive table and word names
examples.caption: Use scalar helpers for individual naming decisions.

assertions: SELECT CASE WHEN inflect('snake', {'firstName':'Ada'}).first_name = 'Ada' AND inflector_to_table_case('UserAccount') = 'user_accounts' AND inflector_to_plural('person') = 'people' AND inflector_to_singular('people') = 'person' AND inflector_to_singular('children') = 'child' THEN true ELSE error('Inflector result mismatch') END;
